related_questions.question: What is the Rutherford County property tax freeze for seniors?
related_questions.snippet: A program adopted by Rutherford County in which qualified homeowners age 65 and older can “freeze” the tax due on their property at the amount for the year they qualify. “If” your property is sold or you no longer qualify for the tax freeze, the property is taxed at the current value and current rate.
